project_type: React SPA - Manga translation tool with multi-panel studio layout
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run typecheck to validate type safety. 2. Run npm run test to run all 25 unit tests. 3. Run npm run build to verify production build succeeds.
contribution_requirements: All existing tests must pass. Build must pass. Do not break MangaViewer when used outside Studio (ReaderPage uses it in strip mode). StudioPageProps interface in App.tsx must remain compatible.
key_patterns: Zustand stores in store/ directory. Components use framer-motion for animations. @heroicons/react for icons. TailwindCSS utility classes. Studio layout uses panel visibility state in useStudioStore.
directory_structure: Root has App.tsx, pages/ (StudioPage, LibraryPage, ReaderPage), components/ (MangaViewer + studio/ subfolder), store/ (zustand stores), features/ (hooks and business logic), tests/unit/ (vitest tests)
